title: Day 965: Imad Aqel Emerges as Sole Surviving Senior Hamas Figure from October 7 — NILI Hunts Last Architect
detail: On May 29, 2026 (Day 965 / Ceasefire Day 232), Israeli and international media identified Imad Aqel — Hamas's 'home front' logistics and weapons infrastructure commander — as the sole remaining senior Hamas figure directly connected to the planning and execution of the October 7, 2023 attack. Aqel (born 1971, Jabaliya refugee camp) heads Hamas's internal logistics, weapons production, and tunnel infrastructure command. He was not a public-facing leader, which Israeli intelligence analysts say was the primary reason he survived Israel's systematic elimination campaign targeting all ~3,000 October 7 participants. Aqel is distinguished from other killed commanders in that he did not directly command the October 7 infiltration units — his role was preparatory: overseeing tunnel construction, weapons stockpiling, and logistical supply chains that enabled the assault. Israel has attempted to kill Aqel before: a 2003 Israeli operation killed several of his associates; in 2009, the IDF bombed his home in Nuseirat — he was not present. Following the sequential killings of Yahya Sinwar (October 16, 2024), Mohammed Shambari (April 29, 2026), Izz al-Din al-Haddad (May 16, 2026), and Mohammed Odeh (May 27, 2026), Aqel's identification represents the culmination of the NILI task force's targeting campaign — four senior architects eliminated in 2026 alone. Ynet reported on May 27–28 that Aqel has survived by operating in deep cover within Gaza's tunnel network. IDF intelligence analysts describe him as a 'shadowy' figure whose avoidance of public communications has made targeting significantly more difficult than the operational commanders. His continued survival does not alter Hamas's functional military command collapse — with Odeh dead, no new Al-Qassam Brigades supreme commander has been publicly announced, and Hamas's military succession remains in crisis. The NILI unit (Shin Bet + Mossad joint operation, publicly revealed by the Wall Street Journal on May 21–22, 2026) continues to compile intelligence on Aqel's location.

media.caption: Imad Aqel — identified as the sole surviving senior Hamas figure from the October 7 planning circle after the killings of Sinwar, Shambari, Haddad, and Odeh

title: Day 965: 33 Days to Supreme Court July 1 Accountability Deadline — Kallner Bill Advancing to First Knesset Plenum Reading; Opposition Pre-Commits to Supreme Court Challenge
detail: On May 29, 2026 (Day 965 / Ceasefire Day 232), Israel's October 7 accountability crisis entered a 33-day countdown to the Israeli Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 constitutional deadline for the government to present a credible investigation framework. The High Court of Justice had ruled that the 32-month absence of any formal independent probe into October 7 was 'unacceptable' and granted the government until July 1 to present an adequate investigation framework. The Knesset coalition's Kallner inquiry bill — which removed 'full, thorough, and independent investigation' from its purpose clause and bars Supreme Court justices from membership — continues its legislative track toward a first full Knesset plenum reading expected in the final days of May 2026. Opposition parties including Yesh Atid, Blue and White, Labor, and the Beyachad alliance of Bennett and Lapid have pre-committed to filing a Supreme Court challenge immediately upon the bill's first reading, arguing it fails to meet the minimum independence threshold the High Court has explicitly set. Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara previously described the bill as 'tailor-made for the government's personal needs.' The October Council (bereaved families' forum) maintained weekly protests outside the Prime Minister's Jerusalem residence, with families of the 1,195 October 7 victims demanding a full independent commission with subpoena power. Israeli polls continue to show approximately 63–72% of the public favoring an independent inquiry: JPPI (63%, May 15, 2026), Hebrew University (72%, April 2026). The Beyachad alliance polled as the leading opposition bloc, pledging an independent October 7 state commission as Day 1 of any new government. Phase Two of the Gaza ceasefire — Hamas disarmament and Israeli withdrawal — remained in total deadlock on Ceasefire Day 232. No new Hamas Al-Qassam Brigades supreme commander has been announced following Mohammed Odeh's killing on May 27.

media.caption: Day 965 — 33 days to Israel Supreme Court July 1 accountability deadline; Kallner inquiry bill advancing to first Knesset plenum reading as opposition prepares challenge
